explanation: Because OULAD records are structured per student-course registration (a single student can enroll in multiple distinct modules such as AAA, BBB, etc.), a standard stratified row-level split (train_test_split stratified on risk) evaluates model performance on course-level prediction. For strict student-level zero-overlap evaluation, GroupShuffleSplit(groups=id_student) can be used so that no student ID ever co-occurs in training and test splits.
